name: pixi-slug
description: GPU-accelerated vector text for PixiJS v6, v7, and v8. Crisp at any size, rotation, or 3D transform.

scripts.build:v6:dev: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs v6 && pnpm run build:fonts && webpack --env version=v6 --env target=dev && tsc -p tsconfig.v6.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node scripts/flatten-types.mjs && node scripts/finalize-types.mjs
scripts.build:v6:prod: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs v6 && pnpm run build:fonts && webpack --env version=v6 --env target=prod && tsc -p tsconfig.v6.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node scripts/flatten-types.mjs && node scripts/finalize-types.mjs
scripts.build:v7:dev: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs v7 && pnpm run build:fonts && webpack --env version=v7 --env target=dev && tsc -p tsconfig.v7.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node scripts/flatten-types.mjs && node scripts/finalize-types.mjs
scripts.build:v7:prod: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs v7 && pnpm run build:fonts && webpack --env version=v7 --env target=prod && tsc -p tsconfig.v7.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node scripts/flatten-types.mjs && node scripts/finalize-types.mjs
scripts.build:v8:dev: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs v8 && pnpm run build:fonts && webpack --env version=v8 --env target=dev && tsc -p tsconfig.v8.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node scripts/flatten-types.mjs && node scripts/finalize-types.mjs
scripts.build:v8:prod: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs v8 && pnpm run build:fonts && webpack --env version=v8 --env target=prod && tsc -p tsconfig.v8.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node scripts/flatten-types.mjs && node scripts/finalize-types.mjs
scripts.build:all:dev: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs all && pnpm run build:fonts && webpack --env version=v8 --env target=dev && webpack --env version=v7 --env target=dev && webpack --env version=v6 --env target=dev && pnpm run build:types
scripts.build:all:prod: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs all && pnpm run build:fonts && webpack --env version=v8 --env target=prod && webpack --env version=v7 --env target=prod && webpack --env version=v6 --env target=prod && pnpm run build:types
scripts.build:all:release: pnpm run build:all:prod && pnpm run build:docs:no-build
scripts.build:fonts: pnpm run build:fallback-font && pnpm run build:math-fallback-font
scripts.build:types: tsc -p tsconfig.v8.json --emitDeclarationOnly && tsc -p tsconfig.v7.json --emitDeclarationOnly && tsc -p tsconfig.v6.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node scripts/flatten-types.mjs && node scripts/finalize-types.mjs
scripts.examples:watch: pnpm run build:fonts && webpack --watch --env version=all --env target=dev --env format=cjs & serve . -l 3000 --cors --no-clipboard
